compiled_state.title: Implement Option A: ruleset-enforced fail-closed review gate on the two-tier flow
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
Implement Option A: harden the two-tier flow into a ruleset-enforced, fail-closed review gate.

Source of truth: docs/handoff/option-a-pivot-plan.md (CONVERGED, review #1-6 + experiments V0.1-V0.12) and docs/adr/0020-two-tier-hardening-over-merge-queue.md. This epic translates plan Phase 2 (§5) + the review-#4/#6 prerequisites into shippable phases. Do NOT use /dso:sprint (the plan was produced by a different process).

NON-NEGOTIABLE REQUIREMENT: every commit reaching `main` must pass an LLM review that is ruleset-enforced (a hard GitHub gate), not merely flow-enforced — and the enforcing checks must fail-closed (never silently green on a precondition/token/expiry failure).

DELIVERY PRINCIPLES (build so surprises surface fast and we can course-correct):
- Warn-first: every story ships its enforcing logic in warn/advisory mode and is validated on live PR2 traffic BEFORE any enforce-flip. The single enforce-flip (final story) is the only hard-to-reverse step and is hard-gated.
- Live-verify each story on real GitHub (admin PAT: provision/read; non-admin: containment reads) AND by the named E-series/V-series experiments.
- Each story names a COURSE-CORRECTION TRIGGER: the observable that, if seen, means stop and re-plan rather than push on.
- Reversibility: warn-mode checks are advisory (no team impact); the enforce-flip story carries the runbook (land the swap with no other PR2 in flight — R8 RED is repo-wide during the live<->file skew window).

SUCCESS CRITERIA (epic closes only when ALL are met + completion-verifier PASS):
- SC1 (single fail-closed gate): a single always-runs required check `review-gate` exists that runs on every base==main PR (no code_changed skip) and fail-closes unless every SHA in origin/main..head is proven reviewed (per-SHA coverage). Verified live: an allowlisted-only PR2 carrying un-reviewed content is BLOCKED (not skip-to-success). [E2/E13]
- SC2 (no silent pass): all review-enforcing CI wrappers fail-closed on precondition/token failure under enforce mode. Verified: a scope-stripped/expired token makes the gate RED (not exit-0) in ALL THREE carriers — review-coverage-invariant.yml, dangling-references.yml, ruleset-invariants.yml. [V0.3a-post-fix, R8 fail-closed]
- SC3 (live ruleset enforces it, durably): live `main` ruleset requires `review-gate` and retains `llm-review`; the merge-pipeline-checks->review-gate swap is reflected on BOTH required-checks.txt and the live ruleset; the R8 live-parity guard fail-closes under enforce so PAT expiry/scope-strip/drift cannot silently disable it. [E6', V0.11]
- SC4 (no false wedge): a clean fully-reviewed PR2 passes; a commit whose diff is entirely within the event-sourced ticket store is exempt and does not wedge; the coverage ledger warm-hits across re-runs (no flaky-check team block). [E5/E8/E14/E15]
- SC5 (instruction surfaces reviewable): behavior-bearing surfaces (docs/**, skills, behavior-driving config) are removed from the review-gate allowlist and become reviewable; genuinely-inert artifacts (images, lockfiles, generated) and the ticket store remain exempt. Verified: a docs-only PR now requires review; an image/lockfile PR still skips. [E11/E-compute-hash]
- SC6 (flow preserved + documented): the two-tier flow is retained and its UX correctness fixes land (descriptive PR1 titles; sprint draft-umbrella lifecycle); docs reflect the final enforced architecture; ADR-0020 updated with execution results.

SEQUENCING: stories 1-4 may proceed in parallel after start; story 5 depends on 1+2+4; story 6 depends on 5; story 7 (enforce-flip) depends on 1-6 ALL verified; story 8 (UX) is independent and may land any time. See each story's dependency links.

comments.body:
REVIEW PANEL CHARTERS (canonical 3-lens panel + convergence reviewer, used for all plan/ADR decisions on this epic). Dispatch lenses 1-3 in PARALLEL as opus agents, synthesize, revise, then run the convergence reviewer; iterate until APPROVED.

LENS 1 — GROUND-TRUTH / ACCURACY:
You are the GROUND-TRUTH / ACCURACY reviewer on a 3-lens panel. Validate EVERY factual + technical claim in [the plan/ADR] against the ACTUAL codebase — read the real files and cite file:line. Flag any claim that is wrong, stale, or unverifiable. Do NOT opine on design taste — only accuracy and technical viability. Pay special attention to the load-bearing empirical assumptions. Output each claim as [ACCURATE] / [INACCURATE] / [UNVERIFIABLE] with evidence. End with VERDICT: APPROVE / APPROVE-WITH-CORRECTIONS (list them) / REJECT (a load-bearing claim is false).

LENS 2 — HISTORICAL:
You are the HISTORICAL reviewer. This project has a long history of workflow-gate changes with recurring gotchas, gaps, and bugs. Refresh your memory from the ticket system, git history, ADRs, and project docs (name the sources). Assess whether [the plan] repeats a known mistake, contradicts a prior decision, or discards a hard-won lesson (e.g. the v4 self-attestation/trailer lesson; the 'built-but-unwired' dormant-check pattern; two-tier/provenance-skip interactions; sequencing/sunk-cost). Tag findings [critical]/[important]/[minor] citing the historical source (ticket id / ADR / commit / file). End with VERDICT: APPROVE / APPROVE-WITH-REVISIONS / REJECT.

LENS 3 — MAINTAINABILITY / RELIABILITY / FITNESS-FOR-PURPOSE:
You are the MAINTAINABILITY / RELIABILITY / FITNESS reviewer. NORTH STAR: every code change reaches main through an LLM review, but reviews run on smaller sub-PRs instead of one giant PR — and with as little friction as possible (a confirmed false-positive should need a SINGLE admin override, not one per tier). Judge whether [the plan] delivers that SAFELY: trace the end-to-end flow, enumerate failure modes (does it degrade to fail-closed/'second override' or to a silent integrity regression?), weigh over/under-engineering and simpler alternatives, and assess maintainability. Tag [critical]/[important]/[minor]. End with VERDICT: APPROVE / APPROVE-WITH-REVISIONS (concrete revisions) / REJECT (propose the better design).

CONVERGENCE REVIEWER (revision-loop closer):
You are the convergence reviewer. A prior 3-lens panel returned a converging set of critical/important findings on rev.1. Verify rev.2 resolves EACH finding (RESOLVED / PARTIALLY-RESOLVED / NOT-RESOLVED + one line of evidence), then scan for NEW defects the revision introduced. End with VERDICT: APPROVED (converged — all blockers/important resolved, no new criticals) / NEEDS-REVISION (exact remaining items).

USAGE NOTE: for the enforce-flip (3ee4) and any security-boundary change, consider adding a dedicated SECURITY RED-TEAM lens (attack the gate: can an un-reviewed SHA reach main? can the agent forge/launder? does any path fail OPEN?).

comments.body: HOT-PATH FIX (defense-mirror pollution, 2026-06-04, commit 0b51459cf6 on story/588e-abec-221f-42c0/defense-mirror-scoping). The CI 'Mirror Tracker Defenses to PR' producer iterated ALL 660 tickets-ref defense blobs and re-posted any whose cited FILE was in the PR diff -> historical defenses on hot files accumulated unbounded. FULL 4-REVIEWER PANEL: rejected the maintainer-named 'change --pr to --pr-number' (pr_number is the dormant sentinel 0; wrong key in two-tier) AND the opus-recommended 'Option A SHA-range ancestry' (squash/rebase/force-push fragility via _squash_rebase_recovery; shallow-clone breaks --is-ancestor; SHA fields also dormant; doesn't bound the existing 657 corpus). CONVERGED on DIFF-HUNK overlap: emit a defense only if a cited line is within +-5 of a line THIS PR actually changed (git diff base...head --unified=0; same +-5 axis as runner.py suppression). No write-side change, immune to squash/rebase/shallow-clone. Convergence caught N-1 (proximity not exact-hunk), N-2 (lineno parse), N-4 (measured: all 94 records have cited_lines, 0 file_paths-only). LIVE-VERIFIED on the 94-record corpus: an unrelated diff emits 0 of 94 (pollution gone); a diff touching the exact cited line check-referential-integrity.sh:98 emits exactly 1 of 94 (the defense citing it) — both halves of the goal proven. ci.yml mirror job wired (fetch-depth:0 + base fetch + --base-sha/--head-sha). DEFERRED (separable, zero-behavior): drop pr_number from cited_lines_fingerprint. Test 6/6, shellcheck clean. Landing via two-tier.
